logline: Under cruel coercion and threats to send her seven-year-old brother to the county gaol, a young maid is manipulated into giving false testimony framing Juliana for witchcraft.
continuity_notes: Following Catherine's dungeon interrogation of Juliana, the conspiracy against Juliana deepens as an aristocratic lord forces a testimony of witchcraft out of the young maid whose brother Juliana saved.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of a dimly lit, wood-paneled library study. An aristocratic lord in formal dark attire stands facing a young maid standing nervously by the open door.

segments.label: LORD (Cold, Authoritative)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Your brother is breathing again.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The young maid steps inside, bowing with a submissive curtsy, keeping her head low and hands clasped.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the maid trembling as she raises her eyes hesitantly.

segments.label: MAID (Meek, Hesitant)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: Yes, my Lord.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Lord standing beside his mahogany desk, looking down with cold, calculating scrutiny.

segments.label: LORD (Probing)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: And who saved him?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the maid's anxious, innocent face.

segments.label: MAID (Quiet, Truthful)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: Lady Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Lord's hand slowly rotating the heavy gold signet ring on his pinky finger.

segments.label: LORD (Measured, Demanding)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Tell me how.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the maid nervously wringing her apron fabric.

segments.label: MAID (Faltering)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: She... she used herbs.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the Lord leaning forward abruptly, his piercing gaze bearing down.

segments.label: LORD (Sharp, Intimidating)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: What herbs?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the frightened maid looking down, shrinking back.

segments.label: MAID (Whispering, Nervous)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: I don't know.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot looking up at the imposing Lord towering above her.

segments.label: LORD (Stern)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: You watched her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the maid, tears beginning to glisten on her cheeks as she defends Juliana.

segments.label: MAID (Tearful, Sincere)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: I watched her save him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning away slowly past the lamp-lit desk toward the rain-streaked window.

segments.label: LORD (Coldly Dismissive)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: That is not what I asked.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot framing the maid from behind as the Lord steps back toward her with commanding stillness.

segments.label: LORD (Accusatory)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Did she use her mother's book?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the maid trembling, tears spilling down her face.

segments.label: MAID (Quietly Weeping)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: Yes.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Lord's sinister, unyielding face.

segments.label: LORD (Insistent, Cornering)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Did she prepare things no physician had prescribed?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the maid clutching her hands together tightly, overwhelmed with guilt.

segments.label: MAID (Choked Sob)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: Yes.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Lord's mouth curling into a sinister, predatory smile.

segments.label: LORD (Sly, Sinister)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: And did she perform anything unusual?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the maid gasping, shaking her head vigorously in panic.

segments.label: MAID (Desperate, Denying)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: No!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile medium two-shot as the Lord looms inches from the maid's face.

segments.label: LORD (Low, Menacing)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Think carefully.

segments.label: LORD (Ruthless)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Your brother is still a pauper.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of the Lord's cold eyes and hawkish profile speaking with chilling finality.

segments.label: LORD (Threatening)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the maid clutching her chest with trembling hands, crying desperately.

segments.label: MAID (Begging, Heartbroken)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: Please, my Lord... he is only seven!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Lord staring down without an ounce of pity.

segments.label: LORD (Cold, Unwavering)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Then help him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.

segments.label: MAID (Crying, Shattered)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: What do you want me to say?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the study as the Lord stands calmly before the trembling servant.

segments.label: LORD (Deceptive)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: The truth.

segments.label: LORD (Leading, Deliberate)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: She drew something around the bed, did she not?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the maid stammering through her tears.

segments.label: MAID (Trembling, Reluctant)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: She... placed dried herbs around him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.

segments.label: LORD (Hypnotic, Coercive)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Around him.

segments.label: LORD (Coercive)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Like a circle?

segments.label: MAID (Faint, Defeated)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: Yes.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up from behind the maid as the Lord leans close to her ear.

segments.label: LORD (Whispering, Trap Snapping)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: And she opened her mother's book...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of the maid's tear-drenched eyes and quivering lips.

segments.label: MAID (Sobbing)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: Yes.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Lord delivering the final trap.

segments.label: LORD (Sinister)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: ...and spoke words you could not understand.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the maid gasping out in desperate agony.

segments.label: MAID (Desperately Defending)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: She was praying!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Lord grinning with sinister triumph.

segments.label: LORD (Taunting)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Praying... or chanting?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the maid breaking down completely.

segments.label: MAID (Hysterically Sobbing)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: I don't know!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as the Lord paces slowly, pointing his finger with clinical, legal precision.

segments.label: LORD (Calculating, Relentless)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: You saw a woman draw a circle of herbs.

segments.label: LORD (Relentless)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: You saw her use a forbidden book.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up profile of the Lord leaning in right in front of the sobbing maid.

segments.label: LORD (Condemning)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: You heard words you could not understand.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of the Lord's mouth and calculating eyes as he pronounces the lethal word.

segments.label: LORD (Deadly, Resolute)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: That is witchcraft.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as the maid steps forward, pleading passionately against his chest.

segments.label: MAID (Crying Out, Desperate)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Lord calmly watching her futile resistance.

segments.label: LORD (Cold, Final)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: That will be your testimony.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the maid's face frozen in horrified realization.

segments.label: MAID (Gasping, Shocked)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: My testimony?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Lord delivering the ultimatum without blinking.

segments.label: LORD (Unyielding)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Before the magistrate.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the maid grabbing both sides of her head, screaming out in utter grief and guilt.

segments.label: MAID (Wailing, Tormented)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: I never said she was a witch!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning his back and walking back behind his desk.

segments.label: LORD (Chillingly Detached)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: You do not need to.

segments.label: LORD (Chillingly Detached)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: I have already written the story for you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the maid clutching her cheeks, crying in heartbreak.

segments.label: MAID (Sobbing)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: She saved my brother...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Lord turning back, resting one hand upon the desk with cold finality.

segments.label: LORD (Inexorable)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: And now... you will save your brother.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The maid's knees buckle completely. She collapses forward onto the polished dark wood floor, groveling in total despair.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High angle looking down as the maid falls prostrate on the floor.

segments.label: MAID (Weeping, Broken)
segments.speaker: MAID
segments.text: I am sorry, Lady Juliana...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot of the Lord looking down dismissively at the prostrate maid.

segments.label: LORD (Cold, Merciless)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Save your tears for the trial.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Side medium shot of the maid kneeling crumpled on the floor in the dimly lit study, her face buried in both hands, weeping uncontrollably as the scene slowly fades into the dark silence.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The heartbroken maid weeps silently in the shadow of the desk, consumed by guilt and powerlessness.
